qualification: Retrospective organization of completed native BMP observations and one instrumented CPU fixture reference. External native BMP has no runtime adapter.

source.note: Execution used an isolated CIMS source copy before this experiment branch existed. Source hashes, original commands and recording IDs preserve that fact. This branch packages the historical run; it was not its execution branch.

scoring.oracle: uint8 impacts; BMP-f32-ceil-cap32 query weights; uint64 accumulation; all documents eligible; score descending then numeric original ID ascending
scoring.native_BMP: u16 score/bound path; strict heap admission; native result ordering retained and separately canonicalized

configuration.timing_boundary: Correctness only; importer/search CLI includes setup and diagnostics; timing output is not compared.

timing_boundary: Correctness comparison only; no performance claim.
interpretation: Observed singleton query: original ID 1047 scores 7 in the independent oracle, while native BMP returns no rows with exit 0. Source search.rs:131-153 initializes current block, scores it only inside a loop over subsequent blocks, and omits final queued block.

Observed constant-score query k=10: all 193 passages score 1; native BMP panics at search.rs:131. Initial threshold equals every block bound; strict ub > threshold creates an empty queue followed by unwrap.
Observed constant-score query k=1000: 192 positive results returned; passage 1047 is absent. This reproduces final-block omission without score ties affecting result cardinality.
Observed empty query panics at query/mod.rs:50. Unknown-only query panics at search.rs:131. Source inspection shows unchecked unwraps on absent maxima or empty block queue.

Observed tie query k=10: all returned scores correct and no score-above-cutoff winner omitted in this minimal case; tied membership and order differ from original-numeric-ID canonical rule. Native heap strict score admission and equal-score comparator explain the policy difference.
limitations: 193 synthetic documents and 12 fixture queries; block sizes 8/32, raw/compressed bounds, k=10/1000, alpha=beta=1.0.
All oracle scores are at most 9120; u16 overflow and real-data external alignment remain untested.
Minimal source causes characterized; no corrected BMP variant was built. Native original binary/source unchanged.
next_action: Create a separately labeled corrected variant and rerun this fixture, then common calibration data.
